name: Duchy of Parma
alt: Duchy of Parma and Piacenza (Farnese and Bourbon)

predecessors.name: Papal States
predecessors.text: Parma, held by the Papal States since 1512

ledger.x: 1545: Pope Paul III grants the duchy of Parma to Pier Luigi Farnese.
1556: Piacenza joins Parma under Ottavio Farnese.
1587: the Stato Pallavicino is annexed; its land lies within the two provinces already held.
1748: Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle returns the duchy to the Bourbons with Guastalla.
1801 to 1802: ceded to France by the Treaty of Aranjuez (21 March 1801); Duke Ferdinand dies 1802.
1802: Ferdinand dies in Parma and the duchy ends.

certainty.note: Modern provinces stand in for the borders; the page gives none.
